title: Decimal
description: Base-10 decimal represented as a STRING. IEEE-754 floating point is prohibited from crossing any financial contract (docs/03). A JSON number is never an acceptable representation of a decimal value.
x-invariants: Must be parsed with a decimal library, never a binary float.
Serialization must round-trip exactly: parse(serialize(x)) == x for all producers.
Scale is significant for money only where the contract declares an explicit scale; trailing zeros are otherwise preserved verbatim to avoid silent precision loss.
